REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: Datadog Metrics API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: submit_metrics, query_timeseries_points
  Setup hints: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/metrics/custom_metrics/, https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/metrics/

  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY, IBM_MONITORING_INSTANCE_ID, IBM_MONITORING_ENDPOINT
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/products/cloud-monitoring

  SDK: google-cloud-monitoring
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: list_time_series, list_metric_descriptors
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.timeSeries/list, https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.metricDescriptors/list

```python
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3

def compare_metric_values(project_id: str, metric_type: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: str, start_time: str, end_time: str) -> dict:
    """
    Compares metric values for two resources or dimension filters over the same window in Google Cloud Monitoring.

    Args:
        project_id (str): The Google Cloud project ID.
        metric_type (str): The metric type to query (e.g., 'custom.googleapis.com/my_metric').
        resource_type (str): The resource type (e.g., 'gce_instance').
        resource_id (str): The resource ID (e.g., 'my-instance-id').
        start_time (str): The start time in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z').
        end_time (str): The end time in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-02T00:00:00Z').

    Returns:
        dict: A dictionary with the metric values for the specified period for the given resource.
    """
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
    name = f"projects/{project_id}"
    interval = monitoring_v3.types.TimeInterval()
    interval.start_time.time = datetime.fromisoformat(start_time).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    interval.end_time.time = datetime.fromisoformat(end_time).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    aggregation = monitoring_v3.types.Aggregation()
    reduction = monitoring_v3.Aggregation.ReductionMethod.REDUCE_SUM
    alignment = monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Alignment.ALIGN_DELTA
    alignment_period = monitoring_v3.types.Interval()
    alignment_period.seconds = 60 * 60  # 1 hour buckets
    aggregation.alignment_period = alignment_period
    aggregation.per_series_aligner = alignment
    aggregation.reduction = reduction
    filter_condition = f"metric.type='{metric_type}' AND resource.type='{resource_type}' AND resource.labels.instance_id='{resource_id}'"
    results = client.list_time_series(name, filter_condition, interval, monitoring_v3.enums.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL, aggregation)

    metric_values = {}
    for result in results:
        for point in result.points:
            if result.metric.type not in metric_values:
                metric_values[result.metric.type] = []
            metric_values[result.metric.type].append(point.value.double_value)

    return metric_values

# Example usage:
# values = compare_metric_values("my-project", "custom.googleapis.com/my_metric", "gce_instance", "my-instance-id", "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-01-02T00:00:00Z")
# print(values)
```
